description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the fifth Patient Qualification and Safety Committee meeting for the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board. The Chair, Ian Dunn, facilitated the review of informed consent, emergency & environmental safety, facilitator & patient ratio, room design & environmental controls, and required safety equipment.
